程序包 com.ta.recruitment.servlet

类 BaseServlet

com.ta.recruitment.servlet.BaseServlet

直接已知子类:
AdminServlet, MOServlet, TAServlet
public abstract class BaseServlet extends javax.servlet.http.HttpServlet
Abstract base class for the role-specific servlets (TA, MO, Admin).

Provides shared helper methods for enriching application maps with TA contact details, serving CV files as HTTP downloads, and handling the common profile-update POST action.

    • enrichAppWithTaInfo

      protected void enrichAppWithTaInfo(Map<String,String> appMap, String taId, DataStore ds)
      Adds extra TA contact fields (taPhone, taDepartment) to an application map by looking up the TA user record.
      参数:
      appMap - the mutable application map to enrich
      taId - the TA user ID to look up
      ds - the DataStore to query

    • serveCV

      protected void serveCV(javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest req, javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse resp, String cvFile, String taName) throws IOException
      Streams a CV file from the uploads directory to the HTTP response. Sets Content-Disposition: inline so the browser can display PDFs inline.
      参数:
      req - the HTTP request (used to resolve the upload directory)
      resp - the HTTP response to write to
      cvFile - the filename of the CV (relative to the uploads directory)
      taName - the TA's name, used to build the suggested download filename
      抛出:
      IOException - if the file cannot be read or the response cannot be written

    • handleProfilePost
